title: Order review: check stock before packing
subtitle: Illustrative example. Select any part to see its role and outcome.

ui.diagramLabel: Order review flow with in-stock and out-of-stock branches

items.label: New order
items.explanation: A new order enters review. The next action is to check whether the ordered item is available in stock.
items.caveat: This is an illustrative process, not a live order status.

items.label: Check stock
items.explanation: Check whether the ordered item is available. Choose one outcome: if it is in stock, pack the order; if it is out of stock, notify the customer. These are alternative paths, not consecutive steps.

items.label: Pack the order
items.explanation: When the item is in stock, pack the order. This is the last action described for the in-stock path; the example does not specify shipping or any later processing.

items.label: Notify the customer
items.explanation: When the item is out of stock, inform the customer that it is unavailable. After this notification, the out-of-stock path ends.
items.caveat: The example does not specify a communication channel or a refund policy.

items.label: End out-of-stock path
items.explanation: The customer has been informed that the item is unavailable. This path ends without packing the order.
